title: Restriction of the full Cartier adjunct to the finite normalization
statement: Let ell be prime and invertible on Y, W its diagonal surface, and n a natural number. Let e be a residue-linear Ext^2 class from the supported constant residue sheaf to the Tate line. If its full integral scalar adjunct equals minus the integral diagonal boundary followed by the compared Kummer unit, then the restriction of e along the residue projection to constant p-adic scalars is heterogeneously equal to the restricted canonical finite Cartier class. The objects, functor and normalization are exactly those of [def-sfb-diagonal-system-interface]; the full residue-linear identification is [lem-sfb-diagonal-cartier-adjunct-uniqueness].

proof.text: Apply full scalar-adjunct Cartier uniqueness to identify e with the named family of canonical residue-linear classes.

Apply congrArg to the exact-functor image, then heq_of_eq. The named class family unfolds to the original canonical class, giving exactly the finite normalization in the diagonal interface. This takes coefficient restriction only after proving the full residue-linear class equality.

theorem diagonal_finite_cartier_normalization (ℓ : ℕ) [Fact ℓ.Prime] (Y : Scheme.{u})
    (hY : IsUnit (ℓ : Γ(Y, ⊤)))
    (hW : IsUnit (ℓ : Γ(diagonalSurface Y, ⊤))) (n : ℕ)
    (e : Ext.{u + 1}
      ((lowerStar (ModuleCat.{u + 1} (diagonalResidue.{u} ℓ n))
        (diagonalImmersion Y)).obj
          (geoCartierConstant (diagonalResidue.{u} ℓ n) (ProjectiveLine Y)))
      (geoCartierLine (diagonalResidue.{u} ℓ n) (ℓ ^ (n + 1))
        (cartierResidue_cast ℓ (n + 1)) (diagonalSurface Y)) 2)
    (he : kummerScalarAdjunct (A := DiagonalAb (diagonalSurface Y))
      (cartierForget (diagonalResidue.{u} ℓ n) (diagonalSurface Y))
      (cartierProIntegralGenerator (diagonalResidue.{u} ℓ n) (diagonalImmersion Y)) e =
      negativeExtProduct (diagonalIntegralBoundary Y)
        (kummerComparedUnit ℓ (diagonalSurface Y) hW n)) :
    HEq (exactFunctorExtImage (diagonalFiniteToPadic ℓ n (diagonalSurface Y)) e)
      (exactFunctorExtImage (diagonalFiniteToPadic ℓ n (diagonalSurface Y))
        (cartierResidueReducedPro ℓ (Fact.out : ℓ.Prime) (n + 1) (diagonalImmersion Y)
          (diagonalImmersion_cartier Y) (diagonalSurface_power_unit ℓ Y hY n)))
